title: Cycle Detection in Sequence (Fast-Slow Pointer)
statement:
You are given an array of N integers representing next-pointer values: next[i] gives the index to jump to from index i. Index -1 means the end of the sequence (no next node).

Starting from index 0, use the fast-slow pointer technique to detect whether the sequence contains a cycle.

Print "Yes" if a cycle is detected, otherwise print "No".
inputFormat:
The first line contains N.
The second line contains N space-separated integers (the next-pointer array).
outputFormat: Print "Yes" if a cycle exists, otherwise "No".
constraints:
1 <= N <= 10^5
-1 <= next[i] <= N-1
If next[i] = -1, node i is a terminal node.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
nxt = list(map(int, input().split()))
# Write your solution here
# Hint: slow moves 1 step, fast moves 2 steps; if they meet, cycle exists
